metaTitle: Weekend getaways and short trips | Comfort Journey
metaDesc: Book weekend getaways for a 2 to 4 day reset. Choose Goa, Uttarakhand or Rajasthan, then get a clear plan and quote from Comfort Journey on WhatsApp.
heroSubline: Trade spreadsheet fatigue for a short break. Pick 2 to 4 days, tell us your dates, and let a real person handle the planning.
whatsAppMsg: Hi Comfort Journey, I want a 2 to 4 day weekend getaway. My dates are [dates]. Please share a suitable plan and quote.
packagesIntro: Goa, Uttarakhand, Nainital and Rajasthan are ready for a short break that gives your calendar room to breathe.
storyHeading: Your leave balance can still have plans
storyParagraphs: You have a Friday evening, a small leave balance and a Monday meeting already sitting on the calendar. That is enough for a proper reset. Choose a beach, hills, wildlife or old-city streets, and we will shape the plan around the time you actually have.

Send your dates and travel mood on WhatsApp. Comfort Journey can arrange the itinerary, hotel choice and private cab, then share the price upfront. Founded in Bhopal in 1992 by Sharad Kumar Mishra, our team keeps a real person close by when your trip is under way.

Come back with better stories than the office group chat. You can spend your short break on a quiet morning, a good local meal or one more view before the return ride. Monday may still arrive, but it will have to work harder to annoy you.

quickAnswer.question: What are the best weekend getaways for a 2 to 4 day break?
quickAnswer.answer: For a 2 to 4 day break, popular picks include Goa for beach time, Rishikesh and Mussoorie for river and hills, Nainital and Jim Corbett for nature, and Rajasthan for forts and food. Comfort Journey can match your dates, hotel choice and transport needs, then share a clear quote on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Can I book a weekend getaway with only two or three days available?
faqs.a: Yes. The page includes 2N/3D and 3N/4D India packages suited to a short break. Share your dates on WhatsApp so the team can confirm what fits your schedule.

faqs.q: Which destinations work well for a 2 night 3 day trip?
faqs.a: Goa and Rishikesh with Mussoorie are the clearest 2N/3D choices in this collection. They give you a change of scene while keeping the plan compact.

faqs.q: How much do short trip packages cost?
faqs.a: The price changes with the destination, travel dates, hotel category, vehicle type and number of travellers. Tell us those details on WhatsApp and we will share an exact quote with inclusions before you book.

faqs.q: Can you plan around my office schedule?
faqs.a: Yes. Every itinerary can be customised around your available leave, preferred pace and places you want to see. The team will suggest a plan that fits the time you have.

faqs.q: What hotels and transport can I choose?
faqs.a: Choose from 3-star to 5-star hotels, plus palaces and villas where available for the trip. Private cabs with drivers can be arranged for your travel needs.

faqs.q: Will someone help during the trip?
faqs.a: Yes. Real people are available on WhatsApp and phone at +91 92039 31912, 24/7 during trips. Contact the team if a route, check-in or plan question comes up.

finalText: Send your dates and preferred mood on WhatsApp. We will return with a short-trip option and a clear quote.
